description: Writing-coach feedback on synthetic drafts. A case passes when the policy is respected (no call under no_ai_assistance; no replacement text under feedback_only), enough comments survive the verbatim-quote check, and none is dropped beyond the allowed share.

cases.prompt: Describe a challenge you faced and what you learned from it.
cases.draft: Debate taught me to listen before I speak. In my first tournament I has argued so fast that I missed my opponent's best point, and we lost. Afterwards our coach asked me to repeat her argument back to her, word for word, and I could not. Since then I take notes on every speech before I answer it. I want to study economics because good policy also starts with listening to the people it affects.

I want to attend Synthetic Lakeside because of it's economics department and the small seminars. Last summer I volunteered at a microfinance office in Lagos, where I seen how small loans changed families businesses. I hope to research how credit reaches women traders.
I grew up between two languages and learned to translate for my grandmother at the market.
